verdict.rationale: Stripe provides robust webhook subscription infrastructure: creating HTTPS webhook endpoints, receiving real-time push events for payments, disputes, and recurring billing, with dispute events also deliverable via webhooks. This works alongside Stripe's MCP server and agent tooling, making it accessible to AI-native/agentic workflows. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of an AI agent subscribing to or consuming webhooks programmatically via the MCP server itself, and independent hands-on confirmation of agentic webhook consumption specifically.
